meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award both lines to B; approver rejects
gaps: The prepared state has only one line item and one bid, so two lines with bids from vendors A and B cannot be tested.
Allocating both lines to Vendor B and verifying Awarded Vendors reads 1/2 cannot be tested in the one-line, one-vendor prepared state.
Filling and submitting the requested multi-line proposal cannot be tested for the stated allocation.
Signing in as the approver and rejecting the proposal with a remark requires another user session.
Verifying that no PO is created after rejection and that the buyer can restart awarding afterward cannot be tested because approver rejection is unavailable.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed event's Master QCS without searching or creating another event.
Reach the awarding screen, which is the closest available screen for inspecting allocation controls.
Allocate the available prepared line to the available vendor; this exercises the closest single-line allocation path, not the requested two-line Vendor B allocation.
Assert the counters for the prepared one-line, one-vendor state so the available allocation is verified without inventing the requested 1/2 result.
Confirm the awarding screen exposes the proposal-creation control.
